title: Design System: Jarvis — daily workspace and original variants

body.purpose: Inherited native Chinese reading stack and line height.

button.purpose: Shared primary, secondary and text actions.

chapter-spine.purpose: Historical A-only vertical chapter marker; hidden below 520px.

day-heading.purpose: Default daily heading; 24px at 850px and below.

day-section.purpose: Calendar, conversation and rail section headings.

day-conversation.purpose: Intent and chat copy; 12px on mobile.

day-action.purpose: Compact daily-panel actions; shared base remains 14px.

day-gap.purpose: Tabular gap values; units remain separate.

acceptedSurfacePatterns.name: Unified module ledger and shared detail

conceptSeed.status: inherited from the game-lab contract; no new roll

acceptedSurfacePatterns.world: Existing C slate/ink/emerald evidence workshop with A quantitative gaps and progression; no token replacement.

patterns.name: Module ledger
patterns.description: One ruled white comparison surface for direction, module-relative standing and coverage, tasks and horizons, and exemplar gap. Unknown remains written; XP stays separate.
patterns.responsive: Four columns above 850px; labeled two-column module sections at 850px; work and comparison span the row at 440px.

patterns.name: Evidence and route document
patterns.description: Shared renderer orders current evidence, sourced exemplar comparison and near/mid/long route. Values keep units and comparability limits; native disclosures hold scoring basis.
patterns.responsive: Document plus 360px Jarvis column, 330px at 1200px. Roadmap stacks and metric bars hide at 1200px while written values remain.

patterns.name: Contextual proposal and mobile panes
patterns.description: Jarvis proposals expose assessment, evidence coverage, gap and horizons before confirmation; stale proposals disable acceptance. Module/document and Jarvis discussion are explicit mobile panes.
patterns.responsive: At 850px only the selected pane displays. Module opening selects the document; analysis or reference discussion selects Jarvis. Pane buttons use aria-pressed.

acceptedSurfacePatterns.scope: Accepted local interaction prototype; personal values and analyses are fictional. Real research, model inference and Agent runtime are unimplemented.

narrative.northStar: Jarvis daily workspace — C 证据工坊 × A 成长图谱
narrative.overview:
The user explicitly prefers C’s evidence workshop with A’s capability graph and quantified gaps. The default `index.html` now opens a unified module overview, with shared module details and the daily calendar available from the same shell. Calendar editing, contextual conversation, reviewable proposals and progress evidence remain one connected workspace. C supplies the slate, ink and emerald document character; A supplies the visible capability topology. This is an accepted prototype direction, not approval of a production identity or runtime integration.

The original fifteen A/B/C views remain at `variants.html`, backed by `app.js`, `styles.css` and `model.js`. Their palettes and signature structures remain valid historical comparison material. They do not require the new workspace to keep its calendar, conversation and graph in separate candidate worlds. The current module composition is recorded in `.impeccable/surfaces/module-atlas.md`; `.impeccable/surfaces/agent-day.md` records the earlier daily refinement, and `.impeccable/surfaces/game-lab.md` records the original comparison phase, including its then-pending preference verdict.
keyCharacteristics: C’s pale slate, white paper, ink blue and evidence green anchor the default workspace.
A’s capability topology connects an explicit gap to a proposed daily action.
Shared module ledgers and evidence documents keep standing, comparable gaps and stage routes legible across different growth directions.
Calendar and conversation share the selected object; proposed changes remain visibly distinct from accepted time.
Chinese system typography, compact supporting text and tabular quantities support an operational surface.
Text accompanies event and evidence states; controls retain visible keyboard focus.
CSS and inline SVG carry the visuals; no raster assets, external fonts or new dependencies ship.

rules.name: Accepted Direction
rules.body: Use C’s evidence palette with A’s capability topology for the default daily workspace. Preserve the original A/B/C variants as comparison history; the accepted prototype preference does not imply production approval.

rules.name: Readable State
rules.body: Retain written event, proposal and evidence states alongside color, borders and the semantic state attributes present on controls.

dos: Do use C’s evidence palette with A’s capability topology in the default workspace.
Do preserve the original A/B/C palettes and views as historical comparison material.
Do retain visible control focus, labeled native fields, written state and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep current time, proposed time, evidence, XP and measurements visibly distinguishable.
Do expose prototype and simulated-data status without claiming a connected model or calendar service.
donts: Don’t describe the user’s C-plus-A preference as pending, or require the accepted workspace to remain three separate candidates.
Don’t treat accepted prototype direction as production identity or runtime approval.
Don’t introduce external fonts or raster imagery into this record; neither ships in the prototype.
Don’t turn compact 10px metadata or removed decorative heading badges into general-purpose typography patterns.
